originalTitle: Market cuts odds of Fed hike after jobs data, but economists still see case for tightening
simplifiedContent: The latest job numbers for July were weaker than expected, which has made people less sure that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next month. Because of this, the futures market is now showing a lower chance of an interest rate increase. Even though some Federal Reserve officials think rates should be increased to combat inflation, experts are still unsure about what will happen with interest rates. The Federal Reserve is closely watching inflation to help make its decisions about future interest rates. This matters because changes in interest rates can affect the overall economy and the stock market.

originalTitle: Dollar falls against yen, euro as weak US jobs data clouds Fed outlook
simplifiedContent: The value of the US dollar went down compared to other major currencies like the yen and euro on Friday. This happened because the US recently reported losing more jobs than expected in July, which is a sign of economic weakness. As a result, people are unsure about what the Federal Reserve (the "Fed") will do with interest rates next. The unemployment rate actually got a little better, but not as many people are working or looking for jobs as in the past. This news is important because it can affect the overall direction of the economy and the stock market.

originalTitle: Raymond Realty Q1 net profit falls 19 pc to Rs 13.43 cr on higher expenses
simplifiedContent: Raymond Realty, a real estate company, made less profit in the first quarter of the year (Rs 13.43 crore) compared to the same time last year, due to higher expenses. However, the company's total income increased to Rs 535.71 crore. The company also reported strong sales, with bookings worth Rs 700 crore, which is a big jump from the same period last year. This means that even though the company's profit decreased, its overall business and sales are doing well. The decrease in profit is mainly because the company had to spend more on operating costs.

originalTitle: Treasury yields fall as jobs report dashes hike bets
simplifiedContent: The interest rates on US government bonds, also known as Treasury yields, have decreased. This happened after a recent report on jobs in the US was released. The report was not as strong as some people thought it would be, which made them less likely to think that interest rates would go up soon. As a result, Treasury yields fell. This matters because it can affect the overall direction of the stock market and influence investing decisions.

originalTitle: Gold hits seven-week high as weak US jobs data dents rate hike bets
simplifiedContent: The price of gold has gone up to its highest point in seven weeks. This happened because the latest job market data from the US was weaker than expected. As a result, people are now less sure that interest rates will be increased soon, which is good for gold prices. This is important because it can affect the overall performance of the stock market and the economy. The increase in gold price is a sign that investors are reacting to the new jobs data and changing their expectations about what might happen with interest rates.

originalTitle: Equities poised for best week since April as payrolls surprise eases rate-hike concerns
simplifiedContent: The US stock market is having its best week since April. This is because a recent report on job numbers, called payrolls, was better than expected. As a result, investors are less worried that interest rates will go up soon. This matters because when interest rates go up, it can make it more expensive for people and companies to borrow money, which can hurt the stock market. The good news is helping to boost the stock market, making it a positive week for investors.
